title: States & Union Territories
description: 100 MCQs: 20 Easy, 50 Moderate and 30 Hard, covering Articles 1–4, Union Territories, State reorganisation, constitutional amendments, schedules, councils and statement/assertion-based questions.

questions.question: According to Article 1, India is described as:
questions.explanation: Article 1 says "India, that is Bharat, shall be a **Union of States**." The word 'Federal' does not appear anywhere in the Constitution.

questions.question: Consider the following statements: 1. Parliament can reduce the area of a State under Article 3. 2. Parliament can increase the area of a State under Article 3. 3. Parliament requires consent of the State Legislature to alter State boundaries. Which are CORRECT?

options.text: 1 and 2 only (State's views are sought but NOT binding)

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT possible under Article 3?

options.text: Forming a new State by separating territory from another State
Giving any territory to a foreign country
Altering the boundary of a State ---

questions.question: Assertion (A): A Bill under Article 3 altering State boundaries is NOT a Constitutional Amendment under Article 368. Reason (R): Article 4 explicitly provides that such laws shall not be deemed Constitutional Amendments.

options.text: Both A and R true; R explains A

questions.question: The expression "Union of India" in Article 1:

options.text: Is the same as "Territory of India"
Includes UTs and acquired territories > "Territory of India" includes States + UTs + acquired territories. "Union of India" includes only States. ---
